title: DE BRUYNE: PSV SAY NO, NAPOLI SAY NO, ALLEGRI REPORTEDLY SAYS NO
description:
Napoli reportedly want €7M for Kevin De Bruyne. Nobody seems to agree on the price.

De Bruyne is 35, with under a year left on his deal. PSV reportedly opened with €2M and Napoli said no. Five million apart is a different planet.

Napoli are tenth in Serie A and may need his passes more than the cash. Allegri reportedly opposes a midseason sale, which makes three noes in one story.

He won six Premier League titles at City. €7M is about a million a trophy. Bargain.

Cash in or keep him? What would you do if you were Napoli? Your move.
